subject: general
question: Who among the following chaired the Parliamentary Consultative Committee meeting on ‘Disaster Management and Capacity Building’ in August 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amit Shah**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Union Home Minister and Minister of Cooperation, **Shri Amit Shah**, chaired the meeting of the **Parliamentary Consultative Committee** attached to the **Ministry of Home Affairs** in **August 2025**.
 
• The primary theme of the meeting was **‘Disaster Management and Capacity Building’**, reflecting India's commitment to strengthening its resilience against natural and man-made calamities.
 
• During the meeting, **Amit Shah** highlighted the significant shift in India's approach from a **relief-centric** to a **proactive and early warning-based** disaster management strategy.
 
• The committee discussed the progress of various initiatives like the **Aapda Mitra scheme**, which aims to train **community volunteers** in disaster-prone districts across the country.
 
• He emphasized the government’s vision of **"Zero Casualty"** during disasters, citing the successful evacuation and management strategies employed during recent **cyclones** and **floods**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Parliamentary Consultative Committees:**
 
 
• These committees are constituted by the **Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs** and provide a forum for **informal discussions** between Ministers and **Members of Parliament (MPs)** on the policies and working of various Ministries.
 
• Unlike Standing Committees, their meetings are usually held during **Parliament sessions** and inter-session periods to facilitate a direct exchange of ideas.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) and Disaster Management:**
 
 
• The **MHA** is the nodal ministry in India for managing **natural disasters** (except droughts, which fall under the Ministry of Agriculture).
 
• It oversees the **National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA)** and the **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF)**.
 
 
 
• **National Disaster Response Force (NDRF):**
 
 
• The **NDRF** is a specialized force constituted under the **Disaster Management Act, 2005**, for the purpose of specialist response to a threatening disaster situation.
 
• As of **2025**, the force has been expanded with more **battalions** and advanced **technological equipment** to reduce response time during emergencies.
 
 
 
• **Capacity Building Initiatives:**
 
 
• Capacity building involves **training**, **resource mobilization**, and **infrastructure development**.
 
• The **National Institute of Disaster Management (NIDM)** plays a crucial role in providing **training** and **capacity building** programs for officials and stakeholders at the **national, state, and district levels**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• The **Disaster Management Act, 2005**, remains the foundational legal framework for disaster governance in India, establishing the **National, State, and District Disaster Management Authorities**.
 
• Financial support for disaster activities is managed through the **National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF)** and the **State Disaster Response Fund (SDRF)**, with the **15th Finance Commission** introducing a specific **Mitigation Fund**.
 
• The **August 2025** meeting also touched upon the use of **Space Technology** and **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** for **Early Warning Systems (EWS)** to provide accurate and timely alerts to the **common citizens**.
 
• **Amit Shah** reiterated that India is aiming to become a global leader in **disaster risk reduction**, aligning with the **Sendai Framework** for Disaster Risk Reduction 2015-2030.
